purpose: FBS-219: the external criteria of US-19001, driving bin/rcf.js against fixture projects (e2e); each case is the existing TS-252 integration case, bound again at e2e level for the release Verify
title: US-19001 external criteria (FBS-219)

testCases.description: rcf verify run --url <preview-url> --fbs <fbs-id> --mode deterministic --hand verifier --verifier-id <id> writes rcf/verify-reports/<fbs-id>/<head12>.json valid as VerifyReport v1 and stdout ends "verify report: <path> <verdict> <verified>/<total>"
testCases.testPointer: test/verify/verify-report-hand.test.js::AC-19001-1: rcf verify run --url <preview-url> --fbs <fbs-id> --mode deterministic --hand verifier --verifier-id <id> writes rcf/verify-reports/<fbs-id>/<head12>.json valid as VerifyReport v1 and stdout ends "verify report: <path> <verdict> <verified>/<total>"

testCases.description: rcf verify run with --hand outside the five hands, or --hand without --fbs, exits 2 naming the flag and writes no report
testCases.testPointer: test/verify/verify-report-hand.test.js::AC-19001-3: rcf verify run with --hand outside the five hands, or --hand without --fbs, exits 2 naming the flag and writes no report

testCases.description: rcf verify run --package <name@version|tarball> --fbs <fbs-id> --hand verifier writes a report with target.kind "package" and target.packageRef and no target.url
testCases.testPointer: test/verify/verify-report-hand.test.js::AC-19001-4: rcf verify run --package <name@version|tarball> --fbs <fbs-id> --hand verifier writes a report with target.kind "package" and target.packageRef and no target.url

testCases.description: with a committed report under rcf/verify-reports/, rcf define validate exits 0 with no unknown-document error and the tree walker does not load it as a chain document

testCases.description: rcf verify run --hand verifier writes only under rcf/verify-reports/<fbs-id>/; a second run for the same head exits 4 with "verify report exists for head <sha7>; pass --replace" and never overwrites
